title: Cognitive Alpha Mining via LLM-Driven Code-Based Evolution

mechanism.domainTask: LLM-driven evolutionary mining of interpretable quantitative alpha factors
mechanism.populationDetail: Each generation filters candidates into a parent pool of at most 32 qualified alphas; no island or maintained genealogy/tree is described.
mechanism.archiveDetail: Elite alphas are preserved in a final candidate pool, and the top two from the previous generation are carried forward; no descriptor niches are stated.
mechanism.replacementDetail: A separate elite/final candidate pool exists alongside the qualified parent pool, but its retention capacity and admission semantics are not fully specified.
mechanism.generationDetail: Initial factors are generated from task guidance; thinking evolution uses unary slight mutation and binary crossover, including crossover followed by mutation.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Quality-checker outcomes and leakage-unit-test result precede the five-metric fitness vector; selected metric results and verbal summaries are reused in generation prompts.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Qualified parent pool is formed by threshold filtering and is capped at 32, but exact per-child parent sampling/count is not described; guidance samples should not automatically be treated as true parents.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Seven-level finance-domain agent specialization and multi-agent code-quality/logic checking before predictive fitness evaluation.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/Cognitive Alpha Mining via LLM-Driven Code-Based Evolution.pdf
